decisionsTitle: «Îi scriem membrului pe email despre comenzi»: one switch for the shop's member emails
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, in Romanian:** «Nu vreau neapărat mail de confirmare comenzi, vreau să fie o bifă — dacă să comunic sau nu prin email cu clientul.»

**Decision.** One switch for the whole shop, in «Magazin» → «Setări» beside «Cum se plătește» and «Cine primește comenzile»: «Îi scriem membrului pe email despre comenzi», stored as `emailMembers` in the `membersShop` setting (a row saved before it, or none, reads as on — the shop wrote to its members from the start, §683). On: «Comanda ta a fost primită» when a member orders and «Comanda ta e plătită» when the club marks it paid, as before. Off: neither goes to the member. The club's own notice to «Cine primește comenzile» is a different thing and stays as it is. The setting is read inside the order's own transaction, so the emails stay in the outbox's transaction (BR-REQ-080-02); nothing is retroactive — an order already placed keeps what was queued. For an order the club places in a member's name (§690) the per-order tick «Trimite-i membrului emailul de confirmare» keeps working but is offered only while the switch is on: off, the tick is not drawn (a one-line note says why) and the service queues nothing even if a request carries it, and the audit row's `emailed` records what was actually queued. The save is audited by shape as before (`shop.settings_saved` now also records whether the switch is on, never a text). Amends §683 and §690.

**Refused.** A per-product or per-order switch for member-placed orders — one decision for the club, not forty. Turning off the club's notice with the same switch — that is «Cine primește comenzile» left empty.
changelogLine: - **«Îi scriem membrului pe email despre comenzi»** — one switch in «Magazin» → «Setări» for the shop's two member emails (received, paid); off, the member gets neither, the club's own notice stays, and the per-order tick for an order typed by the club is not offered. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: With «Îi scriem membrului pe email despre comenzi» off in «Setări», placing an order and marking it paid queue no email to the member while the club's notice is still queued, and with it on (the default, also for a setting saved before the switch) both are queued in the order's own transaction; an order already placed keeps what was queued; an order the club places for a member queues nothing and audits `emailed: false` while the switch is off, whatever the tick says (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The shop's member-email switch is saved only through the service's `canManageShop` check, and the per-order email tick on «Comenzi» is a convenience the service re-checks against the setting, never the permission (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the shop's member emails behind one switch
